identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][tooling] Preserve blocked and unstable PR mergeability states

values.summary: Read the current octocrab state mapping, implement an explicit classification table, add focused state coverage, validate the touched crate, obtain exact review, and publish only after review.

steps.action: Bind issue 5695 with disjoint source and card paths
Replace wildcard mergeability fallback with explicit pending-state mapping
Add focused tests for every supported mergeability variant and merge fail-closed behavior
Run focused validation and exact review before publication

invariants: blocked and unstable are pending rather than stale
Merge eligibility still requires required checks and review
risks: octocrab may add a new enum variant
classification tests can omit a state
pending states can be mistaken for merge eligibility
stop_conditions: The enum variants cannot be verified from the pinned dependency
The change requires merge-authority policy changes
Work would touch provider, Runtime, AWS, or unrelated CI surfaces
